extra.reason: Concept C rendered by scripts/make-icon.swift (reproducible), tuned for small sizes, shipped as Resources/AppIcon.icns and wired into bundle.sh; verified at 128 and 32 px.

AppCommand.bindings is now the only place keys are declared; the menu bar takes its ⌘ shortcut and the in-window buttons take the plain key from the same list, and the palette/help text is derived from it.

Not done as specified: the 256KB tail cap already bounds the work, and stopping at the first old record would silently hide another session's writes if the log were ever out of order - the one thing this feature exists to report. Kept the bounded full scan, now reading newest-first, with the reasoning in the code.
MIT, matching the norm for a small tool; copyright Dylan Thomas. Easy to change before the repo is public.
CFBundleVersion is now the git commit count and CFBundleShortVersionString comes from the VERSION file, so both scripts read one source.
README Install section leads with clone + scripts/bundle.sh, noting that a locally built app is never quarantined, plus requirements and a Developing section.

scripts/release.sh builds a release-config bundle and zips it with ditto (verified: 1.1MB zip unpacks to an ad-hoc signed app); .github/workflows/release.yml tests, builds and attaches it on a v* tag, with Gatekeeper instructions in the release notes.
Three commits: bd's own init, the app (70 files), and the tracker state. CFBundleVersion now reads 3 from the commit count.

Every command now carries keywords, matched with a lower weight than its title, and the search command is titled 'Find in This View'. Tested: fin/find -> Find, reload -> Refresh, kanban -> Board, column -> Display, help -> Shortcuts; Return runs the highlighted row as before.
Help menu now has Keyboard Shortcuts (CMD-/), a hint row 'Press ? anywhere in the window for the shortcut list' since a menu item can only display one key, and a link to the repo.

DisplayText.preview cuts at 512 characters on a word boundary with an ellipsis, and is used as the hover tooltip on id, title, labels and assignee cells plus tree rows and board cards. Tested as a pure function.
Segmented List/Tree/Board control in the view header, next to Display, which keeps the same picker. Both read their names and symbols from DisplayText.layout(Symbol).

Beady it is. Renamed across the executable, bundle id (me.bitsby.beady), window title, env vars, scratch marker, scripts, README and the local checkout (~/projects/beady). GitHub repo not created yet: publishing is the owner's call.

Theme/ThemeColors/RGB in BeadsPresentation with WCAG contrast maths; 8 themes (Dracula, One Dark, Nord, Solarized Light, GitHub Light, One Light + a high-contrast pair). Tests prove body text >= 4.5:1, status/priority/accents >= 3:1, and >= 7:1 for the high-contrast pair.

Every meaningful colour now comes from the theme in the environment: status categories, priorities, blocked, progress, drop targets, selection borders, warning banners and the focus breadcrumb. No literal colours left in the views.

Settings window (CMD-,) with appearance, a theme per mode and text size; CMD-T theme sheet with live swatches; every theme, appearance and text size is also a palette command. macOS Increase Contrast overrides with the high-contrast theme, watched live. All persisted in UserDefaults.
